method.name: amc_remaining_run_survival_v1
method.description: Frozen daily discrete-time logistic remaining-run model. Public copy is bucketed with presentation-safe AMC departure timing; raw probabilities and remaining-day medians stay internal.
method.evaluation_note: Held-out backtest of amc_remaining_run_survival_v1. The validation 95% 7-day operating point held at about 92.5% test precision; the 90% point did not. Production use does not mean the model is final. Ship-gate remains promising_continue. Presentation dates use observation_date + median_remaining_days, lower-bounded by max_show_date; weak segments stay horizon-only. No formal percentage confidence is published.
